reason: I pick dinner from a TikTok video that day and my husband and I already double-buy stuff, so I know I wouldn't keep a digital kitchen up to date. The free version is fine to try, but I wouldn't pay for scanning receipts I'd forget to scan.
objection: I won't keep logging every item I buy and use. If it isn't current it's useless, and I'd stop after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: If my husband and I shared one list that updated automatically when either of us scanned a receipt, and it worked on the first try with Arabic receipts without any manual fixing, I'd pay for a year.
